planets.name: Kepler-378 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-378 with a 28.9-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-378 c was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-378. Its orbit and size follow Rowe et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
